activities.title: Route Map
activities.instruction: Match URL paths to the React components that should render for them.

content.concept: Understand how routes map URL paths to components in a React application.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Navigation Lab
activities.instruction: Choose the correct navigation mechanism for moving between React routes.

content.concept: Navigate between routes using React Router links instead of unnecessary full-page reloads.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Change window.location for every internal route

activities.title: Route Parameter Explorer
activities.instruction: Change the route ID and identify which resource the route should load.

content.concept: Use dynamic route parameters such as /users/:id to identify resources from the URL.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Application Architecture
activities.instruction: Arrange common frontend layers into a maintainable application structure.

content.concept: Understand how routing fits into a frontend architecture containing UI components, pages, state, services and API communication.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
